settings.title: Apply
settings.copy: Tell us who you are, where you post, and why SASSi fits what you make. Takes a couple of minutes.

settings.title: Get approved
settings.copy: We review every application by hand. If it's a fit, you'll get your own SASSi discount code.

settings.title: Share and earn
settings.copy: Post it, share it, carry it. You earn 8% on every sale made with your code — and your audience gets a discount too.

settings.question: When and how do I get paid?
settings.answer: Monthly. We total the sales made with your code at the end of each month and send your commission by GCash or bank transfer.

settings.question: How are my sales tracked?
settings.answer: Through your unique discount code. Every order placed with it is credited to you — and your audience gets a discount for using it, so it's something you can offer rather than just ask.

settings.question: Do I need to own a SASSi bag?
settings.answer: Not required, but it helps. The affiliates who do best are the ones genuinely carrying one.

settings.question: Can I work with other brands too?
What if I have fewer than 1,000 followers?
settings.answer: Our current minimum is 1,000 on your main platform. Grow a little and come back — we'd genuinely like to hear from you.
